onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const reason = inpCompanyDonorContactReason.text?.trim(); const value = inpCompanyDonorContactValue.text?.trim(); if (!reason || !value) { showAlert('Enter a contact and reason.', 'warning'); return; } const result = await qAddCompanyDonorContact.run({ kind: selCompanyDonorContactKind.selectedOptionValue, value, reason }); if (!result?.[0]?.contact_id) throw new Error('No contact was returned.'); await Promise.all([qCompanyDonorContacts.run(), qCompanyContacts.run(), qCompanyProfile.run()]); showAlert('Contributor contact added.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Contact change failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
